How to Fly

Catch every crook under the red beam, carry him to the Jail, and don't let 3 escape!

Touch

  • Fly button: hold to fly — let go and he hovers in place.
  • Joystick: push up to climb, down to dive, sideways to turn and bank. Push harder to dive steeper — dives are fast!
  • Boost button: hold for turbo speed while flying — and hold it on the ground to run.
  • Laser button: hold to fire eye-lasers. A held beam burns a black track wherever it lands — zap a crook to slow him down and make him easy to grab!
  • Land button: settle down onto a rooftop or the street. On the ground the joystick walks (12 mph) — hold Boost to run (25 mph). Hold Fly to take off again.
  • Grab: just touch the crook as you swoop past — then follow the gold arrow to the Jail and he drops right in.

Keyboard & Mouse

  • Space or hold the mouse button to fly. Move the mouse to steer, or use WASD.
  • Shift = Boost  •  F or right mouse button = Laser  •  Z = Land.
  • On the ground, WASD walks (hold Shift to run). Hold Space to take off again.
